third_source.relationship: Explicitly cross-references MRLA 7 entry 147, p. 162. Repetition of dimensions is not evidence of independent remeasurement.

adjacent_entry_checked.result: Dimensions differ from both a values; no demonstrated a/b transcription swap.

finding: All four dimensions agree with their respective sources. Not a unit/order or project transcription error. Neither source establishes the measurement date, technique or cause of discrepancy. Rounding alone does not explain the height gaps. Shared accessions remain strong correspondence evidence; measurement disagreement alone does not demonstrate distinct bowls. Existing insufficient_evidence reviews were not changed.
